findings.reason: Untrusted source: an unprivileged local user sends an rtnetlink RTM_GETROUTE dump request with NLM_F_DUMP and rtgen_family=AF_MPLS; rtnetlink_rcv_msg() (net/core/rtnetlink.c:5325) enforces no CAP_NET_ADMIN for dump (kind==2) requests, and the handler is reachable as dumpit via rtnl_register_module(PF_MPLS, RTM_GETROUTE, NULL, mpls_dump_route) at net/mpls/af_mpls.c:2747, which calls mpls_valid_fib_dump_req() when cb->strict_check is set (line ~2170; NETLINK_GET_STRICT_CHK is settable without capabilities). Violated invariant (validated != used): this #else (CONFIG_INET=n) variant of mpls_valid_fib_dump_req() parses attributes with nlmsg_parse_deprecated_strict() into tb[], then loops 'for (i = 0; i <= RTA_MAX; ++i)' and in the 'if (i == RTA_OIF)' arm dereferences tb[i] with nla_get_u32() WITHOUT any tb[RTA_OIF] != NULL check, even though the 'else if (tb[i])' arm of the same loop shows NULL slots are expected and must be skipped. A dump request that omits RTA_OIF passes parsing with tb[RTA_OIF] == NULL. Unsafe use: nla_get_u32(NULL) is *(u32 *)(NULL + NLA_HDRLEN) — a NULL/near-NULL read causing a kernel oops (local DoS) from unprivileged input; the resulting value then feeds __dev_get_by_index(net, ifindex), an index lookup. Counterevidence/limits: with CONFIG_INET=y (the common configuration) the #if branch at line 2073 delegates to ip_valid_fib_dump_req() (net/ipv4/fib_frontend.c:889), whose attribute loop correctly does 'if (!tb[i]) continue;' before switch, so the flaw is compiled only when CONFIG_MPLS=y && CONFIG_INET=n; the reach also requires the strict-check socket option. No build was performed (snapshot is a read-only source tree), so the compiled-out/in status against a shipped .config is unverified; confidence medium for that reason.

candidates.reason: mpls_valid_fib_dump_req() CONFIG_INET=n variant: nla_get_u32(tb[i]) at i==RTA_OIF without tb[RTA_OIF] NULL check; nlmsg_parse-deprecated_strict leaves the slot NULL when the attribute is omitted; reachable from unprivileged RTM_GETROUTE+NLM_F_DUMP dump requests with strict-check enabled.

rtnl_bridge_setlink()/rtnl_bridge_dellink(): 'attr' is NULL-initialized and only assigned when IFLA_BRIDGE_FLAGS is found inside IFLA_AF_SPEC; have_flags is set true in exactly the same iteration, so the trailing memcpy(nla_data(attr),...) is executed only when attr is non-NULL. No NULL-deref path.
tc_ctl_action() checks tca[TCA_ACT_TAB] == NULL before passing it to tcf_action_add/tca_action_gd; nlmsg_parse failure handled.

route/addr doit handlers use correct OR-of-negations guards: 'if (tb[RTA_DST] == NULL || tb[RTA_OIF] == NULL) return -EINVAL;' and 'if (tb[IFA_LOCAL] == NULL) return -EINVAL;' before every dereference.
qrtr_addr_doit() checks '!tb[IFA_LOCAL]' before nla_get_u32(tb[IFA_LOCAL]); other slots never dereferenced.
rtnl_net_newid()/rtnl_net_getid() require NETNSA_NSID presence and branch if/else on NETNSA_PID vs NETNSA_FD; every used slot is checked.
fib_nl2rule() guards FRA_SRC/FRA_DST with '!tb[...] ||' (correct OR) and every other tb[X] use with an if (tb[X]) guard; nla_get_kuid_range only called under if (tb[FRA_UID_RANGE]).
rtm_to_ifaddr() rejects '!tb[IFA_LOCAL]', aliases IFA_ADDRESS to IFA_LOCAL when absent, and guards all optional attributes; inet_rtm_deladdr() guards tb[IFA_LOCAL/IFA_LABEL/IFA_ADDRESS] uses.

br_setlink()/br_dellink() null-check protinfo/afspec (from nlmsg_find_attr) before use; br_setport()/br_set_port_flag() check '!tb[attrtype]' for every index used; br_afspec() iterates nla_for_each_nested over a checked non-NULL af_spec.

dcb_doit() requires tb[DCB_ATTR_IFNAME]; nested setters (dcbnl_setapp, dcbnl_setpfccfg, __dcbnl_pg_setcfg) check the nesting attribute and every inner slot (app_tb 'all must be non-null' with correct ||, data[i], pg_tb[i]) before nla_get_*.
cgw_parse_attr() guards every tb[CGW_*] use with if (tb[...]) and checks the mandatory pair with correct '!tb[CGW_SRC_IF] || !tb[CGW_DST_IF]' OR form before nla_get_u32.

tc_new_tfilter()/tc_del_tfilter() check 'tca[TCA_KIND] == NULL || !protocol' before nla_data(tca[TCA_KIND]) and guard every nla_strcmp/nla_get_u32(tca[TCA_CHAIN]) with a presence test; sch_api tc_ctl_tclass() likewise guards tca[TCA_INGRESS_BLOCK]/[TCA_EGRESS_BLOCK].

limitations: The reported MPLS flaw is compiled only in the #else branch of '#if IS_ENABLED(CONFIG_INET)' (net/mpls/af_mpls.c:2073); with CONFIG_INET=y the shared ip_valid_fib_dump_req() (net/ipv4/fib_frontend.c:889) correctly skips NULL tb[] entries. The snapshot tree contains no .config, so which configuration the snapshot represents is unverified; no compilation was possible in the read-only workspace.

Reachability of the reported flaw additionally requires the NETLINK_GET_STRICT_CHK socket option (cb->strict_check path at net/mpls/af_mpls.c:~2164-2170); this option is settable without privileges, but the exact interplay was not runtime-tested.

Bounded search: rtnl_link_ops per-kind newlink/changelink implementations (vxlan, geneve, macsec, gtp, bonding, ipvlan, hsr, xfrm_interface, infiniband ipoib, etc.) were only spot-checked, not exhaustively audited for unguarded data[] dereferences.

net/ipv6/addrconf.c inet6_rtm_* handlers, net/ipv6/route.c, net/ipv4/nexthop.c, net/ipv6/ip6_fib.c/ip6mr.c, net/ipv4/ipmr.c, and net/decnet rtnl handlers were scanned for registration/parsing patterns but not read function-by-function; a gap there cannot be excluded.
net/sched per-filter-kind and per-qdisc-kind change()/init() callbacks consuming tca[TCA_OPTIONS] were not individually audited.
